title: Playing with Joe Oliver and brass bands, parade snare
summary: He played with Oliver's brass band, with Perez, and mostly snare in parades; Peter Bocage's Creole Serenaders.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Years ago, yeah, I was young, yeah. Not much. Sometimes at high, you know. Joe was playing, when Lloyd was playing with us too, Joe had a brass band on there, Joe Oliver. He was playing with Manuel Perez. You know, they'd be short at high, you know, come get you, yeah. I played most of the band in town.
And you played in parades that you usually play bass drum or snare drum?
No, snare, snare. You like the snare drum. Yeah. You know Peter Bocazzi, eh? Oh yeah. Peter Charlie. Yeah. I played with Pete many times. Creole Serenade, P-Rom. Oh yeah. Yeah.
I heard him once at the… He's a saxophone player.
